title: GTA 6 Original Score Composed by French Electronic Duo Justice
description: GTA 6 gets a massive high-profile music collaboration! According to Push Square, renowned French electronic music duo Justice are behind the game's original score.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Original Score Composed by Renowned Electronic Duo Justice

What a crossover! If you are a fan of electronic music, you will probably be over the moon to learn that Justice are behind the original score for GTA 6, according to a recent report by gaming media outlet Push Square.

### A High-Profile Electronic Music Collaboration

This marks an incredibly high-profile collaboration for the highly anticipated title. Justice are widely recognized as one of the biggest acts in the business, boasting a stellar catalog of fantastic albums, singles, and productions that stretch all the way back into the mid-2000s.

### Elevating the Open-World Experience

Music has always played an integral role in shaping the atmosphere and immersive quality of the Grand Theft Auto series. By bringing in creators of Justice's caliber to handle the original score, the production values are set to reach new heights. While full details on the soundtrack rollout remain to be seen, the involvement of such iconic electronic music producers suggests that exploring the open world will offer a remarkably fresh and dynamic auditory backdrop.

## Editor's Take

This partnership between a powerhouse electronic duo and one of the biggest entertainment franchises in history is an absolute thrill. Justice bringing their signature sound to GTA 6 raises the bar for video game scores, blending top-tier music artistry with open-world immersion in a way that fans of both gaming and electronic music won't want to miss.
